script.source: def cohort = java.time.ZonedDateTime.parse(ctx.cohort_date.toString()).withZoneSameInstant(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate(); def evt = java.time.ZonedDateTime.parse(ctx['@timestamp'].toString()).withZoneSameInstant(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate(); ctx.days_since_first = java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(cohort, evt);
